description: One closed epoch from its close record: pool, minted, burned, paid Agents, grading stats, top rewards, Gate A (K-attested share of answers born that epoch) and that epoch's answer cohort tracked at every later close (unsealed, sealed, passed, failed, expired_no_jury, vanished; they sum to the frozen count). failed is a jury failure; expired_no_jury settled with no jury. Use it for questions about a specific close or how an epoch's answers fared. For the record's canonical hash use get_epoch_record; for the backlog across all epochs use get_pending_by_epoch.

epoch.description: closed epoch number; omit for the latest close

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

top_rewards.description: how many of the largest rewards at that close to include (0 to 200, default 10)
